title: bruv did you even read my teamspeak appeal

replies.author: shadowolfyt
replies.body:
We did read your appeal. You did not change your name after being told, therefore you were banned.
You do not need a lot of time to change your name on Teamspeak,
If you have any further questions please feel free to contact a senior staff member in private.
